previews.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished social link preview image for the existing tmp.cash website.
Format: wide landscape, exactly 1200 × 630 pixels, aspect ratio 1.905:1. Entire image is the artwork; no mockup frame, browser chrome, outer white border, or devices.
Brand: tmp.cash is experimental temporary ecash backed by held Lightning payments. Existing site uses DM Sans and DM Mono typography, warm cream #f5f3ed, deep charcoal-green #232822, lime #d2ec63, muted olive #646c5d, hairlines #e1e2d8. Use this exact palette and a quiet, precise editorial graphic style. Crisp flat vector-like illustration, subtle paper grain, generous negative space, no gradients or glossy 3D. Typography must be large, clean, beautifully kerned, modern geometric sans, highly legible at thumbnail size. Maintain a 64-pixel safe margin on every edge. Match an elegant open-source software brand, not a crypto exchange.
Use the lowercase wordmark "tmp.cash" near top left, simple dark text, about 42px. Text must be exact with no added wording. Do not invent a logo.

Scene/backdrop: warm cream background with very faint regular dot grid on the illustration side.
Composition: left 58% contains wordmark above a very large three-line headline, right 42% contains a striking oversized minimal hourglass silhouette inside a lime circle. Charcoal hourglass drawn as an elegant continuous outline, tiny lime sand, echoing the site's hourglass theme. A few sparse fine orbit arcs support the motif, kept behind it.
Text (verbatim): wordmark "tmp.cash"; main headline on exactly three lines "Private digital" / "cash." / "No custodian"; one small but readable line below headline "Held in Lightning."
Constraints: headline dark charcoal, period in lime/olive, ample visual breathing room. NO other text. No realistic money, no Bitcoin coins, no charts, no claims of guaranteed safety or anonymity, no padlocks, no wallet UI, no watermarks.
previews.editPrompt:
Use case: text-localization.
Asset type: precise text edit to the existing tmp.cash social link preview image.
Input image: provided local image is the edit target.
Primary request: replace the large motto with the user's exact updated wording: "Private digital cash. No custodian".
Set the headline in three balanced, left-aligned lines:
"Private digital"
"cash."
"No custodian"
Capitalization and punctuation must be exact: capital P in Private, lowercase digital cash, a period after cash, capital N in No, lowercase custodian, no punctuation after custodian.
Use the same clean, bold charcoal geometric sans-serif typography. Fit all three lines in the existing left text area, with generous spacing and a font size around 95px on this 1731px-wide canvas, adjusting slightly for fit. Keep all headline text entirely left of the hourglass circle. Preserve the wordmark above and the small "Held in Lightning." line below; move that small line slightly down if needed to balance the three-line headline.
Invariants: preserve the "tmp.cash" wordmark, cream/charcoal/lime palette, right-side hourglass illustration, lime circle, fine orbital arcs, subtle dot grid, paper texture, and wide canvas/aspect ratio (1731×909). Only change the headline text and its text-block layout. No extra text, no new logo, no changes to the hourglass.
